theme.HelpText: /install, /repair, /uninstall: shyiraho, sana, kuraho. /quiet: uburyo butuje. /norestart: ntukongere gutangiza. DesktopShortcut=1: akamenyetso gafungura porogaramu kuri ecran y'ibanze. InstallFolder="D:\Applications\FuzeVPN": ububiko bw'ibanze. Amavugurura agumana ububiko bwashyizwemo.
theme.SuccessRestartText: Ongera utangize mudasobwa yawe kugira ngo urangize.
theme.SuccessUninstallRestartText: Ongera utangize kugira ngo urangize gukuraho.
theme.FailureHyperlinkLogText: Igikorwa cyahagaze. Reba inyandiko, ukemure ikibazo wongere ugerageze.
theme.FailureRestartText: Ongera utangize kugira ngo urangize gusubiza uko byari bimeze.
theme.FilesInUseLabel: Funga porogaramu zikurikira, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
theme.DesktopShortcut: Kora akamenyetso gafungura porogaramu kuri ecran y'ibanze
theme.PreserveInstallFolder: Ububiko busanzwe bugumaho mu gihe cy'amavugurura. Kugira ngo wimure porogaramu uko ushaka, koresha ububiko bwa verisiyo igendanwa.
msi.Downgrade: Verisiyo nshya ya FuzeVPN yamaze gushyirwaho.
msi.WindowsX64: Iyi porogaramu ishyiraho isaba Windows {Architecture}. Hitamo paki ijyanye na mudasobwa yawe.
msi.Rollback: Uburyo bwa Windows Installer bwo gusubiza uko byari bimeze bugomba gukora kugira ngo ushyireho cyangwa ukureho FuzeVPN mu buryo butekanye.
msi.ServiceDescription: Icunga gusa imiyoboro ya WireGuard na OpenVPN ya FuzeVPN.
native.1: FuzeVPN yashyizweho, ariko serivisi yayo ntiyemeje ko yongeye gutangira. Ongera ukore ishyirwaho kugira ngo usane porogaramu.
native.2: Ntibyashobotse kugenzura verisiyo cyangwa imiterere ya Windows. Reba inyandiko y'ishyirwaho.
native.4: Iyi porogaramu ishyiraho isaba Windows {Architecture}. Hitamo paki ijyanye na mudasobwa yawe.
native.5: Uburyo bwa Windows Installer bwo gusubiza uko byari bimeze bugomba gukora mbere y'igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose cyo kubungabunga FuzeVPN.
native.6: Hitamo ububiko buri kuri iyi mudasobwa bufite inzira yuzuye kugira ngo ushyiremo FuzeVPN.
native.7: Verisiyo nshya yamaze gushyirwaho, cyangwa verisiyo yayo ntishobora kugenzurwa.
native.10: VPN ntiyemeje ko yahagaze. Ishyirwaho ryahagaze amadosiye adasimbuwe.
native.11: Funga FuzeVPN n'umufasha wayo wo kuvugurura, hanyuma wongere ukore ishyirwaho. Nta gikorwa cyahagaritswe ku ngufu.
native.12: VPN ntiyashoboye guhagarikwa mu buryo butekanye.
native.13: Kubungabunga ntibishobora kurangizwa. Ongera ukore ishyirwaho kugira ngo usane FuzeVPN.
native.14: Gusubiza uko byari bimeze bikomeza guhagarika urusobe mu gihe cyo kubungabunga; ongera ukore ishyirwaho kugira ngo usane.
theme.SuccessOpenApp: Fungura FuzeVPN uhereye kuri menu yo Gutangira. Amahitamo yawe bwite yarabitswe.
